name: Shiina
source:
One of the students registered in the Doctor's course of Teito's Institute of Technology. Out of all the students, he is the one that has stayed the longest in the Mikozuka Lab, making him the oldest member.

He's rather unfriendly, and doesn't seem to want to get involved with the protagonist's business.
translation:
One of the students registered in the Doctor's course of Teito's Institute of Technology. Out of all the students, he is the one that has stayed the longest in the Mikozuka Lab, making him the oldest member.

He's rather unfriendly, and doesn't seem to want to get involved with the protagonist's business.
